card.name: Unit endings before exponents or ratios
card.fires_on: The last piece of a measurement unit, such as /cm, /in, mm, /min or per year, right before a superscript number or a following ratio part. It also fires on a closing parenthesis after a distance.

modes.label: Compound unit denominators
modes.description: The denominator piece of a rate or density unit, often just before a superscript exponent.

modes.label: Per-time or per-volume ends
modes.description: The word after per, or the end of a rate, in lab counts and event rates.
